reviser_primary_source_rechecks.title: RightsStatements.org: work and digital-object applicability guidance
reviser_primary_source_rechecks.released_version_or_commit: Official guidance dated 2018-12-21; not a versioned vocabulary release. The cited statement URI families are RightsStatements.org 1.0 where applicable.
reviser_primary_source_rechecks.locator: Sections “Rights statements for in copyright objects,” “Rights statements for objects that are not in copyright,” and “Other rights statements”; term-by-term lists distinguishing both work and digital object from digital-object-only terms.
reviser_primary_source_rechecks.accessed_at_utc: 2026-10-10T05:07:49Z is the UTC clock observation immediately after the combined retrieval; exact per-request completion UTC is UNKNOWN.
reviser_primary_source_rechecks.observed_operation: Official page text was returned by web search retrieval. A subsequent direct open timed out; no collection record was inspected.
reviser_primary_source_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: In Copyright, In Copyright - EU Orphan Work, In Copyright - Rights-holder(s) Unlocatable or Unidentifiable, No Copyright - United States, and CNE/UND/NKC are described as applicable to both the work and digital object. In Copyright - Educational Use Permitted, In Copyright - Non-Commercial Use Permitted, and the other No Copyright statements are digital-object-only. No Copyright - United States has its own location condition. RightsStatements.org notes the terms were designed primarily for digital objects and that additional digitalization-related restrictions should be represented at the digital-object level.
reviser_primary_source_rechecks.applicability: Keep source-asserted subject separate from the vocabulary term’s documented possible scope and from the catalog display resource. If the source subject is unstated or conflicts with the term/profile, retain ambiguity and route to the registrar; do not extend a digital-object statement to the work.
